<div class="job-details-content content">
<div><p><strong>Hiring: Appointment Setter (US Accent | US Timezone | Part-Time)&nbsp;</strong></p><p>We’re looking for a reliable and confident <strong>Appointment Setter</strong> who can communicate naturally with a US audience and consistently show up on time.</p><p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p><ul><li><p>Make outbound calls and follow-ups</p></li><li><p>Book qualified appointments for our sales team</p></li><li><p>Maintain clear, accurate records of conversations</p></li><li><p>Communicate professionally with prospects in a friendly, natural American accent</p></li></ul><p><strong>What we expect:</strong></p><ul><li><p>Strong spoken English with a neutral or American-style accent</p></li><li><p>Availability to work <strong>US business hours</strong></p></li><li><p>Punctuality and strong work discipline</p></li><li><p>Comfort with CRM tools and structured workflows</p></li><li><p>A positive attitude and ability to build rapport quickly</p></li></ul><p><strong>Who this role is perfect for:</strong><br>Someone who enjoys conversations, understands how to guide a lead into a booked call, and values consistency and accountability.</p><p>If you’re interested (or know someone who would be a great fit), drop a message or share your details below. Let’s talk!<br><br>Fill out this form with the&nbsp; audio sample - forms.gle/5aHQsWG2JZZVszQt8</p></div>
